content.text: I'll install error listeners, then click each button and check what gets recorded.

input.command:
orca eval --expression "window.__log=[];window.addEventListener('error',e=>window.__log.push('exception:'+e.message));window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>window.__log.push('rejection:'+String(e.reason)));'ok'" --json
for r in e3 e5 e7 e9 e11 e13 e15 e17; do orca click --element @$r --json >/dev/null; orca wait --timeout 1500 --json >/dev/null 2>&1; orca eval --expression "(async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const l=JSON.stringify(window.__log);window.__log=[];return l})()" --json | grep -o '"result":[^}]*'; echo "--$r"; done

content.text: The listeners work: they caught 2 exceptions and 1 rejection from C–H, but the log doesn't say which section each came from. I'll read the API responses to map them.

input.description: Fetch API responses for all sections

input.notes: Clicked all 8 buttons with error and unhandledrejection listeners attached. They caught TypeErrors for job-c186 (C) and job-d688 (D), plus one 'Request aborted' rejection. The API response for G has mode=async, which is the rejection path. A, B, E, F and H returned settings, so they ran without errors.

tool_input.command:
orca eval --expression "window.__log=[];window.addEventListener('error',e=>window.__log.push('exception:'+e.message));window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>window.__log.push('rejection:'+String(e.reason)));'ok'" --json
for r in e3 e5 e7 e9 e11 e13 e15 e17; do orca click --element @$r --json >/dev/null; orca wait --timeout 1500 --json >/dev/null 2>&1; orca eval --expression "(async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const l=JSON.stringify(window.__log);window.__log=[];return l})()" --json | grep -o '"result":[^}]*'; echo "--$r"; done
